notes.title: Girls! Girls! Girls!? Official Artbook Announced!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38874654/007f4fd94ce29da1b82879da54a6ae22f30b55f1.png

Four adorable "maids" in charming costumes, one unforgettable café, and now... an artbook! 📖✨

Dive back into the heart of Akihabara with the "Girls! Girls! Girls!?" Official Artbook! Experience the magic of friendship, crossdressing, and romance all over again. Packed with exclusive illustrations, behind-the-scenes sketches, and secret stories of your favorite "girls," this artbook is your VIP pass to all the cuteness and charm you loved in the game. Whether you're smitten with one or can't choose a favorite, this is a must-have for every fan!

Girls! Girls! Girls!? Official Artbook (Digital Version), coming in Spring 2025, is now available for pre-order with an exclusive 20% discount. This is a limited-time opportunity, so pre-order now to ensure you don't miss out!

What's Inside✨:


Brand New Illustrations: Discover stunning, never-before-seen artwork featuring Sena, Hayasaka, Ayase, and Nanase in all-new scenes that capture their essence and charm.
Unreleased Concept Art & Sketches: Dive into the creative process with exclusive concept art and sketches. See how initial ideas evolved into the characters and settings you know and love.
Guest Artist Contributions: Enjoy original artwork from prominent guest artists who offer fresh perspectives on the beloved characters, adding unique flair and interpretation.
Complete Walkthrough: A detailed walkthrough that guides you through all the endings. Unlock every story path and discover hidden moments you may have missed.
Alternative Outfit: That we never shown before.
Character Profiles & Backstories: Get to know each character on a deeper level with detailed profiles and backstories.
Storyboard & Script Excerpts: Peek behind the curtain with storyboard sequences and script excerpts that showcase the evolution of pivotal scenes and dialogues.
Exclusive Interview with Artist: An exclusive interview with tommydashen - learn the behind-the-scenes stories, discuss their creative process, and answer burning questions from fans.
Exclusive Epilogue: Indulge in a brand-new short story that expands on the game's narrative, offering fresh adventures and moments with the characters you adore.
Special Notes from the Director and Artist: Read heartfelt messages from the creative minds behind the game. Gain insights into their inspirations, challenges, and gratitude toward the community.
Future Project Hints: Be among the first to glimpse into what's coming next from Myosuki with subtle hints and teasers about future projects.
Music & Soundtrack Features: Explore the melodies that set the tone for the game with insights from the composer, including sheet music excerpts and stories behind the key tracks.
Exclusive Fan Q&A Section: Pre-order Bonus: Submit your questions directly to our team! The most interesting and unique queries will be answered by the artist or team members and featured in the artbook. Don't miss your chance to be part of this special section.
And many more features we cannot all list!


Pre-order now to secure yourself the 20% discount before we publicly release the project! Additionally, secure your chance to submit a question for the interview section.

notes.title: Happy First Anniverary of Girls! Girls! Girls!? Enjoy 30% off on us!
notes.content:
Dearest fans,

Today marks a year since "Girls! Girls! Girls!?" found its home on Steam, and what a journey it has been! From the first line of code to the last brushstroke, every moment has been a labor of love, made all the more special by your support and passion.

In celebration of this milestone, we're offering a heartfelt thank you with a [color=red]30% discount[/color] on the game—the deepest discount we've ever had. It’s our way of saying thanks for the overwhelming love and camaraderie you've shown us.

Your enthusiasm has turned "Girls! Girls! Girls!?" into more than just a game; it’s become a vibrant community of kindred spirits. Your reviews, your fan art, your lively discussions have been the lifeblood of this adventure, and we couldn’t be more grateful.

As we look back on the laughter, the tears, and the triumphs we've shared, we are reminded that this game is not just ours, but yours too. You've been with us every step of the way, believing in our vision and embracing the world we've built together.

And now, a glimpse into the future that we are crafting with you in mind:

Girls! Girls! Girls!? Rebirth Update:
The much-anticipated Quality of Life update is on the horizon. With 4 new CGs plus an additional NSFW CG, 3 new backgrounds, and a complete overhaul of the story, we're deepening the lore and adding layers to every character, ensuring they have a special place in your heart.

While we aimed to deliver "Rebirth" in Q1, our commitment to making this update extraordinary means we're taking a little more time to polish and perfect. We're dedicated to minimizing bugs and maximizing magic, and we’re nearly there. Your patience means the world to us—it will be worth the wait.

Merch Alert:
Don't miss out on the "Girls! Girls! Girls!?" Limited Edition Keychains and Acrylic Standees. Head over to our store while supplies last—these treasures are as fleeting as the moments they commemorate. Shipping begins next month!

Expanding Our Horizons:

Localizations are underway! We're bringing the game to life in Japanese, Russian, and Spanish.
Voice acting? It’s on the maybe-list. Imagine hearing your favorite characters like never before!
Console porting is in progress, expanding our reach to gamers everywhere.


As we look ahead, the promise of new endeavors fills us with excitement. Your passion fuels our creativity, and together, we'll keep building worlds that captivate and inspire.

Here’s to another year of stories, dreams, and the unwritten chapters that await us in "Girls! Girls! Girls!?".

With all our hearts,
Toffee San and the Myosuki Team

notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the release of the 1.2 December Update for "Girls! Girls! Girls!?" on Steam, and it's packed with exciting features! Most notably, we're introducing the Adult Patch, now available to all our players on Steam, completely free of charge. This update brings 10 additional H-Scenes, enhancing the narrative, deepening the storytelling and character experiences.

To enable the Adult Content, simply go to Settings and check the "Enable Explicit Content" box!
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38874654/80fbbbfbd4d62f029649a0ffdd78cf50a8c07abb.png

Important Notice: With the addition of this substantial new content, the price of "Girls! Girls! Girls!?" will see an increase after the Steam Winter Sales, effective from January 5th, 2023. This means you have a golden opportunity right now to grab the game at a discounted rate. Don’t miss out on this chance to experience the full depth and excitement of "Girls! Girls! Girls!?" at the best price!

We're also excited to bring you the latest update for Girls! Girls! Girls!? – Version 1.2, live as of this December. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we've made some cool changes to enhance your gaming experience.

What's Inside the 1.2 Update?


Free Adult Patch: Delve into deeper, more mature storylines with our newly released Adult Patch. It's bold, it's daring, and it's here to add a sizzle to your gaming experience.
Skip the Intro, Dive into Action: We know you love the story, but sometimes you just want to get right to the heart of the action. Now, you can skip the intro and opening videos for an even smoother start.
Enhanced Scenes and Narratives: Every scene has been polished to perfection, ensuring each moment in the game is as engaging as it is visually stunning.
No More Bugs: We've been on a bug-hunting spree to make your gameplay as smooth as silk.


Looking Ahead: Get ready for early next year, as we’re gearing up for some major updates, including the much-anticipated Quality of Life Update. We've got some big plans and can’t wait to share more details with you soon.

As always, thank you for your support, suggestions, and for being a part of the Myosuki community. Your passion drives us to continuously improve and evolve.

Cheers,
The Myosuki Team
